events.title: Important Bug Fix #4
events.summary: Important Bug FixMultiple critical bugs have been identified and fixed in this update. Critical issues affecting vehicle driving and the Gate system have been resolved, improving overall gameplay stability and reliability.Thank you to everyone who reported these issues and helped us identify them. We will continue working without slowing down to maintain and further improve the stability of the game. We will keep monitoring player feedback and address additional issues as quickly as possible.

events.title: Important Bug Fix #3
events.summary: Important Bug FixA critical bug affecting the Experience/Level system has been identified and fixed. This issue could cause incorrect experience and level progression under certain circumstances.Thank you to everyone who reported this issue and helped us identify it. If you encounter any other bugs after the update, please let us know through our community channels. We will continue monitoring feedback and release additional fixes as quickly as possible.
